aquarela.name: Watercolor
aquarela.description: Soft ink blots spread and blend slowly, like watercolor on wet paper.
arco-iris-ascendente.name: Rising Rainbow
arco-iris-ascendente.description: Rainbow bands keep rising through your setup, from bottom to top.
arco-iris-respirando.name: Breathing Rainbow
arco-iris-respirando.description: Your whole setup in a single color that travels the spectrum, with gentle breathing.
aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Green and violet curtains of light rippling like the northern lights.
batimento.name: Heartbeat
batimento.description: A double pulse of light to the rhythm of a heart.
bolhas.name: Bubbles
bolhas.description: Colorful bubbles rise, grow and blend over a dark background.
caldeirao.name: Cauldron
caldeirao.description: A bubbling potion: green liquid rippling at the bottom and bubbles that rise and pop.
caleidoscopio.name: Kaleidoscope
caleidoscopio.description: Colorful shapes mirrored around the center, spinning and changing color nonstop.
cerejeira.name: Cherry Blossom
cerejeira.description: Pink petals falling slowly over a dark wine background, like a cherry tree at night.
estrelas.name: Starry Sky
estrelas.description: Points of light that appear and fade over a dark background.
chama-neon.name: Neon Flame
chama-neon.description: Neon-colored flames rise from the bottom of your setup, with intense glow and fire-like motion.
chamas.name: Flames
chamas.description: Fire rising from the bottom of the canvas, with adjustable intensity.
chuva-digital.name: Digital Rain
chuva-digital.description: Columns of light falling with trails, in retro terminal style.
cometa.name: Comet
cometa.description: A bright comet crosses your setup leaving a colored tail.
correnteza.name: Current
correnteza.description: Layered water currents cross each other with glowing foam, like the sea pulling you in.
empilhar.name: Stacking
empilhar.description: Color blocks fall and stack until they fill your setup; once full, everything clears and starts again.
enxame.name: Swarm
enxame.description: Dozens of light points fly together like a swarm, following a leader that roams your setup.
espiral.name: Spiral
espiral.description: A colorful spiral spinning from the center of the canvas.
faiscas.name: Sparks
faiscas.description: Sparks rise and fade over a soft background color.
fantasmas.name: Ghosts
fantasmas.description: Translucent light blobs drift through your setup, appearing and vanishing as they change color.
fogos-de-artificio.name: Fireworks
fogos-de-artificio.description: Rockets rise and burst into showers of colorful sparks that fall slowly.
gradiente.name: Dual Gradient
gradiente.description: A smooth transition between two colors, optionally in motion.
hiperespaco.name: Hyperspace
hiperespaco.description: Stars stretch out from the center, like jumping to light speed.
lampada-de-lava.name: Lava Lamp
lampada-de-lava.description: Warm blobs that rise, merge and sink slowly.
lua-de-sangue.name: Blood Moon
lua-de-sangue.description: A swarm of red sparks circles a crimson moon that pulses slowly.
nebulosa.name: Nebula
nebulosa.description: Clouds of glowing gas that blend and pulse slowly between two colors, like a nebula in space.
neon-deslizante.name: Sliding Neon
neon-deslizante.description: Neon bands sweep across your setup in sequence, each one in a rainbow hue.
oceano.name: Ocean
oceano.description: Deep waves in blues and turquoises, calm and relaxing.
onda-espectral.name: Spectral Wave
onda-espectral.description: Every color of the spectrum sliding across the canvas in waves.
ondulacao.name: Ripples
ondulacao.description: Rings of color spread from random points, like drops in water.
plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Organic fields of color that blend continuously.
por-do-sol.name: Sunset
por-do-sol.description: A warm gradient that breathes slowly between orange, pink and purple.
respingos.name: Splashes
respingos.description: Colorful paint splashes appear across your setup with droplets around them, fading little by little.
roda-de-cor.name: Color Wheel
roda-de-cor.description: A wheel with every color spins from the center of your setup, smooth or in slices.
sirene.name: Siren
sirene.description: Alternating between two colors on opposite sides, with quick flashes.
sonar.name: Sonar
sonar.description: A radar beam sweeps from the center leaving a fading trail, revealing points along the way.
sonho-neon.name: Neon Dream
sonho-neon.description: Soft pink and cyan waves blending and sliding, with a retro dreamy vibe.
synthwave.name: Synthwave
synthwave.description: A striped neon sun on the horizon and a perspective grid rushing toward it, with an 80s vibe.
tempestade.name: Storm
tempestade.description: Dark clouds and rain, split by lightning that suddenly lights up your whole setup.
varredura.name: Sweep
varredura.description: A bar of light that travels across your setup from one side to the other.
